entries.name: Grace Hopper
entries.req: Audit stale/current LLVM and QEMU coverage leaves; return exact refresh commands and acceptance; read-only, no QEMU.
entries.resp: LLVM C-CodeGen and translation evidence were stale; refresh LLVM 19631a leaves before coherence; preserve QEMU L1 656/747 as a hard break; found reserved BSTART.TMA strict-roundtrip mismatch.

entries.name: Barbara Liskov
entries.req: Partition 91 QEMU form gaps and identify a safe semantic implementation batch; read-only, no QEMU.
entries.resp: All 91 forms are owned by open architecture issues #140/#141/#144/#148/#149/#150/#151; no safe mapping-only or L2/L3 batch. BSTART.TMA reserved-selector inconsistency is outside the 91 and belongs to ISA issue #152.

entries.name: John Backus
entries.req: Validate the 999 sentinel and focused 523 speed-stack experiment against current CLI/assets; read-only, no QEMU.
entries.resp: Corrected the command to stage-b train with explicit QEMU and four expanded speed flags; froze 38B promotion threshold and kept timeout throughput distinct from specdiff correctness.

manager_decisions: Refreshed current-SHA compiler/translation leaves and retained QEMU L1 hard break.
Created LinxISA/linx-isa issue #152 instead of widening LLVM or assigning QEMU semantics to reserved selectors.
Ran 999 strict sentinel, 523 300-second promotion probe, and one bounded 900-second correctness attempt serially.
Stopped after 900-second live-timeout; did not claim SPEC train closure.
Fixed explicit --qemu parsing so future focused runs do not require a redundant QEMU environment variable.
